description: This Java source file defines an exception mapper class `UnsupportedParameterExceptionMapper` that handles `UnsupportedParameterException`. It transforms the exception into a JSON API response indicating validation errors for unsupported parameters. The class is part of the Fineract project and uses JAX-RS annotations and Spring annotations.

classes.name: UnsupportedParameterExceptionMapper
classes.description: A class that maps `UnsupportedParameterException` to an HTTP 400 Bad Request response with detailed validation error information.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an `UnsupportedParameterException` into a JAX-RS `Response` object containing validation error details.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns an integer code representing this specific error mapper.
